component.name: MQTT Probe
component.summary: Explore MQTT brokers, topics and messages
Explorer les brokers, sujets et messages MQTT
Explorar brokers, temas y mensajes MQTT

description.p: MQTT Probe is a native desktop application for exploring MQTT brokers, topics and messages.

ul.li: Live topic tree with search and payload previews
JSON, text, diff and chart views for message payloads
Publish composer with QoS, retain and history
TCP, TLS, mutual TLS, WebSocket and secure WebSocket transports
Multiple broker profiles and six interface languages
